requirements.general: • Compiladores C (c17) e C++ (c++20). • É recomendado o Clang 15 ou mais recente. • Isso deve ser instalado a partir do código-fonte no Linux. • Por exemplo: tar -xzf SDL2-2.26.1.tar.gz sudo make install • libgtk-3-dev

source_text.general:
[Dependencies]
- git
- C (c17) and C++ (c++20) compilers.
  - Clang 15 or newer is recommended.
- SDL2
  - This has to be installed from source under Linux.
  - For example:

    ```bash
    wget https://www.libsdl.org/release/SDL2-2.26.1.tar.gz
    tar -xzf SDL2-2.26.1.tar.gz
    cd SDL2-2.26.1
    ./configure
    make -j $(nproc)
    sudo make install
    ```

- libgtk-3-dev

requirements.system: É necessária uma GPU compatível com Direct3D 12.0 (Shader Model 6), Vulkan 1.2 ou suporte a Metal Argument Buffers Tier 2 para executar este projeto. As GPUs mais antigas que devem ser compatíveis para cada fornecedor são: • GeForce GT 630 • Radeon HD 7750 (a de 2012, não confundir com a série RX 7000) e mais recentes • Intel HD 510 (Skylake)
requirements.build: As instruções sobre como compilar este projeto podem ser encontradas no arquivo [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). A compilação requer uma cópia do jogo, e a geração do código desmontado a partir do qual ele é recompilado é uma etapa separada, gerenciada pelo submódulo `lib/gga`.

source_text.system:
[System Requirements]
A GPU supporting Direct3D 12.0 (Shader Model 6), Vulkan 1.2, or Metal Argument Buffers Tier 2 support is required to run this project. The oldest GPUs that should be supported for each vendor are:
* GeForce GT 630
* Radeon HD 7750 (the one from 2012, not to be confused with the RX 7000 series) and newer
* Intel HD 510 (Skylake)
* A Mac with Apple Silicon or an Intel 7th Gen CPU with MacOS 13.0+

On x86-64 PCs, a CPU supporting the SSE4.1 instruction set is also required (Intel Core 2 Penryn series or AMD Bulldozer and newer). ARM64 builds will work on any ARM64 CPU.

If you have issues with crashes on startup, make sure your graphics drivers are fully up to date.

requirements.build: • *Baixe:** a versão do Windows na página de lançamentos do BlueWake. 1. Descompacte a pasta inteira em qualquer lugar e execute `BlueWake.exe`. Ele não está assinado, então o Windows pode dizer que protegeu seu PC: escolha **Mais informações** e **Executar mesmo assim**. 2. Na primeira vez, ele pede a imagem do seu disco. Ele verifica se é o disco dos EUA, prepara-o uma vez (alguns segundos; um `.rvz` é primeiro descompactado em um ISO) e lembra-se dele.

source_text.build:
[Windows]
**Download:** the Windows build from [BlueWake's Releases page](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/bluewake/releases/latest).

1. Unpack the whole folder anywhere and run `BlueWake.exe`. It is not signed, so Windows may say it
   protected your PC: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
2. The first time, it asks for your disc image. It checks that it is the USA disc, prepares it once (a few
   seconds; an `.rvz` is first unpacked to an ISO) and remembers it. Later launches start the game straight away.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a Direct3D 12 GPU and a CPU with AVX2 (Intel Haswell, AMD Zen or newer).

The settings (F1) have four tabs: **Display** (fullscreen; the frame rate: 30 FPS, 60 or 120 FPS with frame
interpolation, the display's own rate up to 240, or the experimental 60 Hz game logic; resolution, filtering), **Controls** (mouse and stick cameras), **Mods** (aspect ratio, Better Wind Waker,
quick doors, climbing, HD textures) and **Sound and files**, with **Save state** and **Load latest state**
at the bottom. Saves, settings, save states (`states`), the prepared disc and session logs are in
`%APPDATA%\BlueWake`.

Building it yourself from your disc (Visual Studio's clang, Python, CMake and Ninja): see
[docs/WINDOWS.md](https://github.com/elliotttate/Wind-Waker-Recomp/blob/windows-release/docs/WINDOWS.md)
on the `windows-release` branch, where the Windows port lives.

source_text.build:
[BUILDING]
- Take a cue and bin of the US release of Mega Man Legends, and place it in the disks folder.
- Rename the Track 1 bin to mml1.us.track1.bin. (Track 2 is just an empty 32MB file)
- run ``make extract_disk``
- run ``make split_all``
- run ``make``
- To make a new disk image of the game, run ``make disk``.

gameplay_evidence.observed: Relato técnico Beta4.1 confirma importação de dados próprios e entrada em saves/cenas jogadas, mas no Intel testado o 3D ficava branco; não é prova de boa jogabilidade nessa configuração.
Jogador de Steam Deck afirma que o port funcionava antes da Beta5 e passa a cair no launcher após atualizar; logs identificam reeot modificado na Beta5.
Beta5 distribui instalador, payload e hashes, refere engine reeot e playthroughs do autor; isso corrige a alegação anterior de inexistência de runtime.

Documento oficial declara inventário incompleto das bibliotecas do payload e blocos .eotp com recursos completos de substituição; não certifica pacote livre de assets. A release Beta5 afirma conter licenças, mas não resolve documentalmente essa divergência.

Inspeção HTTP206 do diretório ZIPBeta5 encontrou413 entradas,18avisos de licença e patchesEOTP/EOTP2. Aviso interno credita reeot e declara não conter dados do jogo; o documento oficial THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES declara substituições completas em algunsEOTP. Preservados nomes,tamanhos,CRC e hashes dos avisos; nenhum runtime executado. A divergência sobre recursos ainda precisa de reconciliação específica.

limitations: Código público cobre principalmente instalador; runtime/payload é componente separado.
Relatos consultados não confirmam uma sessão Beta5 Windows limpa do início ao fim; há regressão Steam Deck e histórico de 3D branco.
O ZIP de1,3GB não foi baixado integralmente: diretório/avisos lidos por faixasHTTP206, sem execução. Isso não certifica todo conteúdo nem prova ilegalidade.
assessment.reason: Distribuição oficial e runtime existem. A pendência é confirmar a procedência dos recursos de substituição no payloadBeta5: o ZIP mantémEOTP/EOTP2 e um aviso de ausência de dados do jogo, enquanto a documentação oficial declara dados completos de substituição. Suspensão reavaliável por comprovação insuficiente de distribuição, sem concluir ilegalidade ou inexistência de port.
reinclusion_conditions: Manifesto e documentação reconciliados com o payloadBeta5, identificando origem e condições de distribuição dos recursos de substituição e dos componentes.
Evidência específica de gameplay da distribuição revisada com mídia própria; launcher fechado e falta de receitaGetAll, isoladamente, não impedem reinclusão.
review_flags: A nota de licenças ainda descreve geração EOTP anterior, enquanto Beta5 usa outro runtime. Sua aplicação integral ao payload Beta5 não foi confirmada; não é prova de infração. Decisão final de catálogo deve resolver esse desalinhamento, não presumir ilegalidade.

Se a procedência oficial e uso de mídia própria forem considerados suficientes após reconciliação, reclassificar como functional_manual_install; não excluir por falta de fonte completa do runtime ou de receita GetAll.

source_text.installation:
[Windows launcher]
The launcher handles resolution, display mode, VSync, frame-rate limits, monitor and GPU selection, filtering, language, controls, saves and local achievements.

Start the game through `Launcher.exe`; it launches `SpiderManEOT.exe`. The installer remains separate from the installed game.

The limiter offers values up to **120 FPS**. Whether the game actually reaches them depends on the scene, hardware and settings.

Transition stutter and frame pacing remain major targets for V2.

[Installation]
1. Download the installer attached to the matching GitHub Release.
2. Let it download and verify the matching PC Edition support package.
3. Select a supported local Xbox 360 source.
4. Choose an empty destination folder and complete installation.
5. Start the installed `Launcher.exe`.

For an online installation, download the installer from the same release as the matching payload. For an offline installation, place the matching payload ZIP beside the installer or select it in the installer. Do not mix installer and payload files from different beta versions.

Installation guides: [English](INSTALL_EN.md) · [Русский](INSTALL_RU.md) · [Deutsch](INSTALL_DE.md) · [Français](INSTALL_FR.md) · [Italiano](INSTALL_IT.md) · [Español](INSTALL_ES.md)

The input can be an XDVDFS ISO, a ZIP containing the game root, a ZIP containing a GOD image (the installer unpacks it itself onto a drive with room and checks every fragment's length), an extracted folder containing `Default.xex` and `Data`, an outer folder containing one compatible game root, or a GOD/SVOD container. A GOD image may be selected at any level a player is likely to click: the outer folder, the title-id folder, `00007000`, the container file itself or its `.data` directory. If a selected directory contains one ISO or ZIP, the installer opens it automatically.

After a successful installation, the source ISO, GOD or extracted folder is no longer needed. The PC Edition runs entirely from the chosen destination and is not tied to the source drive letter. Saves and installer caches use the current Windows user's profile rather than a developer-specific path.

**A container extension or header alone is not enough.** The current reader handles SVOD/GOD; it does not support every STFS package that happens to start with LIVE, PIRS or CON.

**Which dumps work**

The installer recognizes compatible Xbox 360 sources by file contents, including the level
packages that contain embedded dialogue. The language checks cover both shared text files
and scene subtitles. A container name, region label or matching `Default.xex` alone is not
enough to prove that its text files can be reconstructed correctly.

Recorded revisions, named on screen when they match:

- `usa-europe-retail` and `usa-europe-retail-r2`: two USA/Europe retail revisions.
- `eu-retail`: the PC Edition original-language baseline.

source_text.system:
# Burnout 3: Takedown — static recompilation

A static recompilation of the Xbox version of Burnout 3: Takedown (Criterion, 2004)
into a native Windows executable. The game's own x86 code is lifted to C by the
[xboxrecomp](https://github.com/sp00nznet/xboxrecomp) toolkit. It boots through
its real entry point and runs its own menus, races and renderer on the toolkit's
Xbox runtime. No game logic or screen is hand-written.

**Generated source is not distributed.** The repository holds the build glue, the
per-title data and the docs. You supply your own disc image; the recompiler runs
on your machine and writes the C into a gitignored folder.

![Two-player split-screen race, both cars off the line](docs/screenshots/hero_splitscreen.gif)

*Two-player split-screen, recorded headless with `--record`-style per-flip frames and scripted pads.*

## Status

**Alpha.** Every game mode boots, renders and plays, one or two players, driven by
an Xbox/XInput pad. It is not yet fun to play: the NV2A GPU is emulated in
software, so menus run at about 14 fps and races at 2–4 fps on a 12-core machine.
There is no save profile yet, so every launch replays the tutorial videos.

| Mode | Players | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Race (Single Event) | 1 | plays to the finish |
| Time Attack | 1 | plays |
| Road Rage | 1 | plays |
| Crash | 1 | plays: launch, pile-up, score |
| Race | 2, split-screen | plays |
| Road Rage | 2, split-screen | plays |
| Double Impact | 2, split-screen | plays |
| Team Crush | 2, split-screen | plays |
| Party Crash | 2–8, pass the pad | plays |
| Xbox Live / System Link | — | not attempted |

Known gaps: vertical streaks over the menu backdrop movie, seams in the sky dome,
bump-mapped (dot-product) texture stages read as zero, and no profile saving.
[ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) has the list; [docs/boot.md](docs/boot.md) has what it
took to get here, fix by fix.

This is one title in the xboxrecomp family and follows its house style: the
toolkit carries everything that
source_text.installation:
### Quick start: the installer

1. Download **`Burnout3-Installer-windows-x64.exe`** from the
   [latest release](https://github.com/sp00nznet/burnout3/releases/latest) and run it.
   It isn't signed, so SmartScreen asks first: **More info**, **Run anyway**.
2. **Choose folder…**: the folder your `.iso` is in. **Build my recomp**.

   It downloads this repo and the xboxrecomp toolkit into `%USERPROFILE%\recomp`
   (**Change** picks another place), then runs `Setup.cmd` below with no questions:
   it installs whatever is missing, and Windows asks for permission once, for the
   Visual Studio Build Tools. **Show details** has the full output; every run is
   also logged under `recomp\logs\`.
3. **Play Burnout 3**. Opened again later, the installer starts at that button.

[recomp-launcher](https://github.com/sp00nznet/recomp-launcher) builds the
installer from [`launcher/launcher.json`](launcher/launcher.json).
source_text.build:
## Building from source

`regen.sh` runs the toolkit's pipeline on `default.xbe`. The stages are XBE parser,
disassembler, library-function identification, ABI analysis and the recompiler.
CMake then builds the generated C against the xboxrecomp runtime. That runtime
supplies the Xbox kernel, a software NV2A GPU, the MCPX audio processor, a USB
OHCI host with emulated pads, and the XMV movie player. See
[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) for which part owns what.

The C is regenerated, not edited. If the output is wrong, the fix goes in the
toolkit's recompiler or in this repo's per-title data
(`config/seed_functions.json`, `src/game/main.c`), never by hand in `gen/`.
